title: About Aerogela
content:
About Aerogela

Aerogela is an editorial directory focused on the global aerogel industry. We organize manufacturers, distributors, equipment suppliers, and research-service providers into searchable listings and landing pages so buyers, engineers, researchers, and business-development teams can discover relevant companies faster.

What Aerogela covers

  • Company listings for producers, distributors, equipment/materials suppliers, and research services.
  • Application and product landing pages for topics such as industrial insulation, EV batteries, cryogenic systems, aerogel blankets, testing, and materials R&D.
  • Directory tools including filtering, compare, claim listing, submit listing, and contact workflows.

What Aerogela is not

  • We are not a manufacturer, trading desk, or certification body.
  • Directory inclusion does not equal endorsement, investment advice, regulatory approval, or a guarantee of commercial performance.
  • Public information can change, so users should confirm fit, pricing, specifications, and compliance directly with the organization before making procurement or technical decisions.

How to use the directory

  1. Browse the main listings directory or a focused landing page.
  2. Use filters to narrow by location, main product, application field, and review status.
  3. Use Compare Listings for side-by-side review.
  4. Use Request Quote / Contact Supplier for outreach.
  5. If you represent a business, use Claim Listing or Submit a Listing.

Trust and directory standards

We publish supporting pages that explain how listings are reviewed, what our verification labels mean, and how to request updates or corrections:

  • How Listings Are Reviewed
  • Verification Policy
  • Editorial Policy

Contact and corrections

If you need to correct a listing, claim a company profile, or request outreach support, please use the published workflows below:

  • Submit a Listing
